commercial_refresh.rule: Treat the completed nightly GitHub snapshot as the commercial state for the whole delivery day. Do not fetch fresher price/discount/review/history/store data again for the 08:00 delivery.

known_expiry_guard.rule: A known sale_end_utc is a local logical expiry bound. If it is already past at delivery time, suppress that stored offer without fetching new information. Taste cache remains valid.

responsibilities: consume the completed nightly pre-AI payload
finish any required price-blind taste verdicts and persist them through taste inbox/checkpoint
consume precomputed purchase context and deal scenarios
form the complete user-facing mailing text
on failure write data/production/daily_ready/preparation_status.json without replacing the last successful complete artifact

allowed_work: apply known expiry timestamps locally without network
